title: Add White/Black/Orange/Yellow UI themes with persistence and toggle UI

requirements.summary: Extend theme state to support exactly White/Black/Orange/Yellow with localStorage persistence and apply on load (including backward compatibility for existing light/dark values).
acceptanceCriteria: Theme options include exactly: White, Black, Orange, Yellow.
Selected theme is persisted under the existing theme storage key (or a clearly documented replacement key with backward compatibility for existing 'light'/'dark' stored values).
Reloading the page preserves the previously selected theme.
No console errors occur when switching themes.

file_operations.description: Update the theme hook to use a 4-theme model (white/black/orange/yellow), migrate existing stored values ('light'->'white', 'dark'->'black') while continuing to read/write the existing storage key, and apply the selected theme on load by setting a document-level attribute (e.g., data-theme) and maintaining the 'dark' class for the Black theme for compatibility with existing dark-mode styling.

requirements.summary: Define CSS custom property sets for White/Black/Orange/Yellow themes so semantic Tailwind tokens (background/foreground/card/border/primary/accent/ring/etc.) change with the selected theme.
acceptanceCriteria: Each of the four themes produces a clearly distinct look by changing at least background/foreground/card/border/primary/accent/ring variables.
Black theme results in a dark UI (equivalent to current dark-mode behavior or better).
White theme results in a light UI (equivalent to current light-mode behavior or better).
Orange and Yellow themes apply orange/yellow-forward primary/accent styling while maintaining readable contrast for text and controls.

file_operations.description: Extend the base theme variable definitions to include four explicit theme variable sets keyed off the document theme selector (e.g., :root[data-theme="white"], :root[data-theme="black"], :root[data-theme="orange"], :root[data-theme="yellow"]). Ensure each set updates at least --background/--foreground/--card/--border/--primary/--accent/--ring (and related foreground vars) to create distinct White/Black/Orange/Yellow looks, while keeping the existing Blue/Purple/Green data-color-scheme overrides functioning.

requirements.summary: Update ThemeToggleBar to switch among White/Black/Orange/Yellow with accurate labels and aria-labels while keeping the existing Blue/Purple/Green color-scheme control.
acceptanceCriteria: ThemeToggleBar provides a control that cycles or selects White/Black/Orange/Yellow.
The theme control’s visible label matches the currently selected theme.
aria-label(s) mention the correct theme names and no longer refer only to 'Light/Dark mode' if that is no longer the only behavior.
The existing color-scheme switcher (Blue/Purple/Green) continues to work as before.

file_operations.description: Replace the current light/dark toggle behavior with a 4-theme cycle/select control (White, Black, Orange, Yellow), update the visible label to match the active theme, and update aria-label text to reference the correct theme names and available options; keep the existing Blue/Purple/Green color-scheme toggle unchanged.

requirements.summary: Ensure the ThemeToggleBar circular indicator automatically reflects the active theme using semantic tokens and remains visible across all themes.
acceptanceCriteria: Switching to each of the four themes updates the indicator colors without additional user actions.
Indicator uses semantic theme tokens (primary/accent) rather than hardcoded colors.
Indicator remains visible with sufficient contrast across all four themes.

file_operations.description: Adjust the indicator styling (if needed) to rely strictly on semantic token classes (e.g., bg-primary, bg-accent, border-border, ring-ring, ring-offset-background) so it stays legible and updates automatically for White/Black/Orange/Yellow without introducing hardcoded colors.
